sentences.text: The second GTA 6 unlocks at midnight, a hundred million downloads will literally melt the global internet.
Eleven fifty-nine and fifty-nine seconds.
His heart is louder than his fans.
His trembling finger hovers over the download button, sweat pouring down his face.
Midnight.
Click.
Across the world, data centers start glowing red like toasters.
Lightning shoots out of the servers.
Technicians in hard hats run around with fire extinguishers.
Gauges explode, one by one.
Back in the bedroom, the download bar crawls to ninety-nine point nine percent.
One second remaining.
Then the router on the desk bursts into a cloud of black smoke.
No internet.
Not on his street, not in his city, not anywhere.
Total blackout.
Millions of gamers flood the streets in their headsets.
They climb telephone poles and plug ethernet cables into potatoes and car batteries.
Just one more megabyte.
Please.
